snippet.title: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition | PlayStation Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the enigmatic world of The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition.
Explore mysterious places, unravel intricate puzzles, and uncover secrets hidden for decades.

Coming 19th November 2026, Wishlist Now: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018772
